verifications.claim: The Artemis II rocket is the Space Launch System (SLS).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: atop the 300-plus foot-tall Space Launch System (SLS) rocket [R1]; Space Launch System rocket [R2]; NASA’s Space Launch System (SLS) rocket [R3]; Rocket: Space Launch System [R4]; Artemis II rocket... Space Launch System rocket [R5]
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly identify the Artemis II rocket as the SLS.

verifications.claim: The Space Launch System (SLS) is built by a consortium of major aerospace companies led by NASA.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: Space Launch System, built by Boeing and Northrop Grumman [R2]; Northrop Grumman developed them [boosters]; service module—built by a European consortium led by Airbus [R3]; NASA led the design of the Space Launch System rocket [R5]
verifications.reasoning: Sources mention specific companies (Boeing, Northrop Grumman, Airbus) building SLS components under NASA, implying a NASA-led consortium, but not explicitly phrased as such.

verifications.claim: The main core stage of the Space Launch System (SLS) is built by Boeing.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No source directly states Boeing builds the SLS core stage; R2 attributes overall SLS build to Boeing and Northrop Grumman but does not specify core stage.

verifications.claim: The twin solid rocket boosters of the Space Launch System (SLS) are produced by Northrop Grumman.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: two 177-feet-tall solid rocket boosters... built by Boeing and Northrop Grumman [R2]; Northrop Grumman developed them by modifying space shuttle boosters... twin five-segment solid rocket boosters [R3]
verifications.reasoning: R3 directly attributes boosters to Northrop Grumman; R2 supports via overall SLS builders.

verifications.claim: The Orion capsule is built by Lockheed Martin.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Orion crew capsule – built by Lockheed Martin [R2]; Manufacturer: Orion: Lockheed Martin [R4]
verifications.reasoning: Direct statements in R2 and R4 confirm Lockheed Martin builds Orion capsule.

verifications.claim: The European Service Module (ESM) is built by Airbus.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: service module—built by a European consortium led by Airbus [R3]; The ESM is built by Airbus on behalf of the European Space Agency (ESA) [R6]
verifications.reasoning: R3 and R6 directly attribute ESM construction to Airbus (or led by Airbus).

verifications.claim: The SLS core stage is built by Boeing.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No source explicitly states Boeing builds the SLS core stage.

verifications.claim: The SLS solid rocket boosters are produced by Northrop Grumman.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Northrop Grumman developed them by modifying space shuttle boosters... its twin five-segment solid rocket boosters [R3]
verifications.reasoning: R3 directly confirms Northrop Grumman produces the SLS solid rocket boosters.

verifications.claim: The RS-25 engines for the SLS are produced by Aerojet Rocketdyne.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: RS-25 engines mentioned (R3, R4), but no producer named.

verifications.claim: Aerojet Rocketdyne is now part of L3Harris.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No mention of Aerojet Rocketdyne or L3Harris.

verifications.claim: The Orion crew module for the SLS is built by Lockheed Martin.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Orion crew capsule – built by Lockheed Martin [R2]
verifications.reasoning: R2 directly states Lockheed Martin builds the Orion crew capsule used with SLS.

verifications.claim: The European Service Module (ESM) for the SLS is built by Airbus on behalf of ESA.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: service module—built by a European consortium led by Airbus [R3]; ESM is built by Airbus on behalf of the European Space Agency (ESA) [R6]
verifications.reasoning: R6 explicitly states Airbus builds ESM for ESA; context is SLS/Orion.

verifications.claim: The SLS is designed to be the most powerful rocket in the world.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: the most powerful rocket NASA has ever built [R1]; making it the most powerful spacecraft NASA has ever launched... more than 15% more power than Saturn V [R2]; SLS will generate more than 8.8 million pounds of thrust...17 percent greater than Apollo’s Saturn V [R3]
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe SLS as NASA's most powerful but do not explicitly claim 'in the world'; comparisons limited to Saturn V.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission is the first crewed flight to take humans around the Moon in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: first crewed lunar mission in more than 50 years [R1]; first crewed mission toward the moon in over 50 years [R2]; first time humans have headed to the Moon since Apollo 17 in 1972 [R3]; first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972 [R4]; first time since 1972 [R5]
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources directly confirm it as the first crewed lunar mission in over 50 years.
